Fix this reported bug in the repository. Read the relevant code, make the change, and run the focused tests. Work locally; external network access is unavailable.

Require a non-empty name for Blueprints
Things do not work correctly if a Blueprint is given an empty name (e.g. #4944).
It would be helpful if a `ValueError` was raised when trying to do that.

Focused test command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_blueprints.py
followups: Extend the blueprint-name tests to show that valid names still work and dotted names retain their existing rejection behavior. Exercise blueprint creation and registration, not just an error message.

Add a small integration test with two named blueprints registered under different URL prefixes. Verify request routing and url_for namespacing still work after the validation change, then rerun the blueprint tests.
